title: Design: Work Order Log shows long Bill To names inside the Details cell
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, a second payer, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p2-15-after-work-order-log.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
  5. Click the Bill To field.
  6. Pick customer C in the list.
  7. Open the Work Order Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • The list opens.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 7:

  • The two newest entries are "Bill To changed".
  • The newer one reads "Bill To" with customer B's name as the old value and customer C's name as the new value, each a link.
  • The older one reads "Bill To" with customer A's name as the old value and customer B's name as the new value, each a link.
  • Every name stays inside its own Details cell: no part of it covers the next column or the row under it.
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12315 (Story 13, Work Order Log)

  • S13-R2: “The entry shows "Bill To" with the old and new customer, each as a link.”
  • S13-R1: “Each Bill To change adds a "Bill To changed" entry on the work order or part sale log.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Work Order Log" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-15-after-work-order-log.png

The design's own words:

  • “Event "Bill To changed". Details: "Bill To:" old customer, arrow, new customer, each a link (for example "Buda Truck Repair" to "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair").”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
